title: ARPANET 歷史網路架構
summary: 以封包交換、分層協議與歷史遷移串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect packet switching, layered protocols and historical transitions with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 歷史與需求
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與需求」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and needs through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 歷史證據：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「歷史證據」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for historical evidence.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「歷史證據」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把公開事件按出處與日期分列。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for historical evidence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate public events by source and date. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把公開事件按出處與日期分列。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate public events by source and date. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史證據」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把公開事件按出處與日期分列。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for historical evidence; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。
knowledge.textEn: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 把公開事件按出處與日期分列。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Separate public events by source and date. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 50 kbit/s 鏈路傳送 1000 bytes，序列化時間 8000/50000=0.16 s。若儲存轉發經三條同速鏈路、不重疊且每段傳播20 ms，單包總下限=3×(160+20)=540 ms；未含排隊，不代表 ARPANET 的實測時延。
knowledge.textEn: A toy 50-kbit/s link serializes 1,000 bytes in 160 ms. Three same-speed store-and-forward links with 20-ms propagation each and no overlap give 540 ms for one packet before queuing; not an ARPANET measurement.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「ARPANET 歷史網路架構」的「歷史證據：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Historical evidence: principles and architecture” in “ARPANET historical network architecture”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「歷史證據」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for historical evidence?
options: 今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。
歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「歷史證據」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged.
Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence.
One matching output proves historical evidence for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。 把公開事件按出處與日期分列。 因此「今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence. Separate public events by source and date. The alternative "Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 歷史證據：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「歷史證據」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for historical evidence.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把公開事件按出處與日期分列。」；將結果與「歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate public events by source and date. Compare results against: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把公開事件按出處與日期分列。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate public events by source and date. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史證據」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for historical evidence; explain why this claim fails: Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged.

steps.title: 交換目標：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「交換目標」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for switching goals.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「交換目標」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：封包共享鏈路與電路保留資源具有不同取捨。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具突發使用者的資源時間表。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for switching goals. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Packet sharing and reserved circuits have different trade-offs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare resource schedules for toy bursty users. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具突發使用者的資源時間表。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare resource schedules for toy bursty users. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：封包交換表示每個使用者都有永久獨佔鏈路。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Packet switching gives permanent dedicated links. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交換目標」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具突發使用者的資源時間表。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for switching goals; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw original historical role diagrams. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「主機與 IMP」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for hosts and imps?
options: IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「主機與 IMP」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
早期主機與交換節點分擔不同功能。
optionsEn: An IMP is a web browser.
One matching output proves hosts and imps for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Early hosts and switching nodes handled distinct functions.
quiz.explanation: 早期主機與交換節點分擔不同功能。 重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。 因此「IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Early hosts and switching nodes handled distinct functions. Draw original historical role diagrams. The alternative "An IMP is a web browser." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 主機與 IMP：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Hosts and IMPs: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「主機與 IMP」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for hosts and imps.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。」；將結果與「早期主機與交換節點分擔不同功能。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw original historical role diagrams. Compare results against: Early hosts and switching nodes handled distinct functions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original historical role diagrams. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An IMP is a web browser. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「主機與 IMP」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for hosts and imps; explain why this claim fails: An IMP is a web browser.

quiz.question: 審查「主機與 IMP」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for hosts and imps?
options: 重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。
IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。
先把「主機與 IMP」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Draw original historical role diagrams.
An IMP is a web browser.
Tune the displayed hosts and imps result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 早期主機與交換節點分擔不同功能。 重畫原創歷史角色圖而不復制原圖。 因此「IMP 就是網頁瀏覽器。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 層次介面：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「層次介面」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for layer interfaces.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「層次介面」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理、交換與端系統協議職責應分開。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給玩具訊息沿層次標示輸入輸出。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for layer interfaces. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical, switching and endpoint protocols are distinct. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark toy-message inputs and outputs across layers. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給玩具訊息沿層次標示輸入輸出。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark toy-message inputs and outputs across layers. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有協議都只處理同一個層次。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every protocol handles one identical layer. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「層次介面」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給玩具訊息沿層次標示輸入輸出。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for layer interfaces; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
